A '''machine gun''' was a type of [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]].<ref name="RPG2" /> They fired heavy caliber [[Slug/Legends|slugs]], and were capable of rapidly firing thousands of rounds a [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
